issues: 截图直接铺满白底画面，全景就是一张平铺网页，没有舞台、光和主体感
急推前没有任何预告，观众不知道要看哪张卡，“点名”只靠推进本身
落定后只是周边轻压暗 7%，目标卡和邻卡几乎一样亮，特写缺乏焦点
运动模糊回波间距大，小字在急推中段能数出一层层重影
特写之后 60 多帧画面完全不变，没有配套信息，尾帧不成海报
changes: 换 ember look：暖黑舞台 + 顶部主光 + 窗口身后橙色背光 + 地面反光与浮尘；截图装进带标题栏的浏览器窗口，全景后仰 11° 像产品摆在舞台上，急推同曲线拉正到正视特写
急推前一拍四只橙色角标从外扩 150px 收拢锁定 card4（snappy 16f），预备回拉时同步外扩呼吸；角标挂在页面坐标里，急推后自然变成特写取景框
急推改 log 空间强 ease-in 0.69→2.48，按目标卡屏幕位置插值保证单调收向画面中心；阻尼余弦回弹到 2.34（6%）；到位帧暖色曝光闪 8f 衰减
点名加重：周边压成 86% 暖黑、目标卡浮起 + 橙色轮廓光；运动模糊子帧间距压到 ≤6px，高速帧每层补微模糊把回波抹成连续拖影
新增跟随拍：回弹收干后相机平滑左移 320px，右栏落一组读数（眉题 → 232px “−41%” 逐字升起 → 发丝线 → 两行说明），压暗起点跟着卡右缘走；时长 120→132f，尾段 24f hold 极缓推近
issuesEn: The screenshot simply filled a white frame — the wide shot was a flat web page with no stage, light or sense of subject
Nothing telegraphed the target before the push, so the viewer had no idea which card mattered
After landing the surroundings dimmed only 7%, so the target card was barely brighter than its neighbours
Motion-blur echoes were spaced so widely that small text showed countable ghost copies mid-push
After the close-up nothing changed for 60+ frames and there was no supporting information, so the last frame was not a poster
changesEn: Ember look: warm-black stage with a top key light, orange backlight behind the window, floor glow and dust; the screenshot sits in a browser window tilted back 11° like a product on stage, and the push straightens it to a face-on close-up on the same curve

One beat before the push, four orange corner brackets contract from 150px out to lock onto card4 (snappy 16f) and breathe outward during the wind-up; they live in page space and become the close-up's framing brackets

The push is now a log-space strong ease-in 0.69→2.48, interpolated by the target's screen position so it converges monotonically to centre; damped-cosine bounce to 2.34 (6%); a warm exposure flash decays over 8f on the hit frame

Stronger call-out: surroundings drop to 86% warm black, the card lifts with an orange rim light; blur sub-frames are spaced ≤6px with a small per-layer blur on fast frames so echoes smear into a continuous streak

New follow-through beat: after the bounce the camera glides 320px left and a right-column readout lands (kicker → 232px “−41%” rising per character → hairline → two lines), with the scrim edge tracking the card; duration 120→132f with a 24f slow-push hold
